title: Add response body assertion to catch empty 200 responses
root_cause: Tests assert HTTP 200 status but never check response body size. Empty responses pass silently.
fix_description: Add assertion: response body length must be greater than zero for all 200 responses on auth and data endpoints.
fix_code_template:
# Add after existing status assertion
assert len(response.content) > 0, f"Empty response body on {url} - silent failure detected"
assert response.json() is not None, f"Invalid JSON response on {url}"
business_impact: Without this fix: empty auth tokens pass test suite. Users silently de-authenticated in production.
runbook: 1. Find all test files asserting status_code == 200. 2. Add body length assertion after each. 3. Add JSON validity check for API endpoints. 4. Run pytest to verify new assertions catch the injected failure.

title: Lower error rate alert threshold on payment-critical paths
root_cause: Payment path alert threshold set at 2%. Real failures hide at 1.8%. Any error rate above 1% on payment paths should page.
fix_description: Patch the detector configuration to use 0.5% threshold for payment paths instead of global 2% threshold.
fix_code_template:
# Payment-critical paths need tighter thresholds
PAYMENT_PATHS = ["/api/checkout", "/api/payments", "/api/orders"]
ERROR_THRESHOLD_PAYMENT = 0.005  # 0.5%
ERROR_THRESHOLD_DEFAULT = 0.02   # 2%

def get_threshold(path: str) -> float:
    return ERROR_THRESHOLD_PAYMENT if any(p in path for p in PAYMENT_PATHS) else ERROR_THRESHOLD_DEFAULT
business_impact: Without this fix: checkout errors at 1.8% go undetected. $42,000 revenue loss per 8-hour window.
runbook: 1. Identify payment-critical API paths in the codebase. 2. Apply path-specific thresholds. 3. Verify detector flags 1.8% error rate on /api/checkout. 4. Add regression test for threshold logic.

title: Add AbortController timeout to all fetch calls on checkout path
root_cause: fetch() calls on checkout have no timeout. Silent retries cause 3-6x latency spikes. Users see frozen UI.
fix_description: Wrap all checkout fetch calls with AbortController and 8-second timeout. Add explicit timeout assertion in tests.
business_impact: Without this fix: payment gateway retries silently double-charge customers. 312 customers affected per incident.
runbook: 1. Find all fetch() calls without timeout. 2. Wrap with AbortController or asyncio.wait_for. 3. Set timeout to 8000ms for checkout, 5000ms for other endpoints. 4. Add latency assertion in integration tests.

title: Add viewport visibility assertion for confirmation modal after order submit
root_cause: After order submission, tests check modal exists in DOM but not whether it is visible in viewport. Modal at top:-9999px passes DOM check but is invisible to users.
fix_description: Add getBoundingClientRect() assertion after order submit. Modal top must be >= 0 and < viewport height.
fix_code_template:
# Add after order submission
async def assert_modal_visible(page):
    modal = page.locator("#confirmation")
    await modal.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=5000)
    bbox = await modal.bounding_box()
    assert bbox is not None, "Confirmation modal not found in DOM"
    assert bbox["y"] >= 0, f"Modal off-screen: top={bbox['y']}px - silent failure"
    assert bbox["y"] < 900, f"Modal below viewport: top={bbox['y']}px"
business_impact: Without this fix: users see blank screen after payment. Duplicate orders placed. 312 double-charges per incident.
runbook: 1. Find all test files that submit forms or trigger modals. 2. Add bounding_box() assertion after each submission. 3. Verify assertion fails on checkout_broken.html. 4. Verify assertion passes on checkout_healthy.html.
